_what: The SHAPE of substrate/reagent-autobalance-<fleet>.json (tools/m59-reagent-autobalance.mjs). Copy it beside this file, rename it for your fleet, and edit it -- or use `node tools/m59-autobalance.mjs set <Character> <key> <value> --fleet <f> --by <you> --why <reason>`, which records the edit. No file, or no loop for a character: nothing is autobalanced and every keeper buys and sells exactly as before.

Scooter._why: Practise haste / super strength / resist poison while farming the Icky Cave; bank in the Swines hall.

Pepe._why: Keep haste and super strength up for the whole lap on the keeper's own town trips; go to town when either cannot be kept up.
